Hi Rex,

Thanks for asking the question.

Here is the answer: If you see just below my entry, there is a blue rectangle, only partially visible. It says H1 FTR. The chart which you are looking at is an M5. You have a valid reasoning for going short on m5 when price comes back after making the engulf, but the problem is there is no HTF supply above it to support the engulf on the short side.

HTF tells you where the price is standing currently with respect to big players and LTF gives you entries. Try not to fixate on LTFs only coz you want to take more trades. Instead, go out to H4, daily, weekly, monthly and mark out each and every demand and supply which is created. wait for the price to come back to these zones and then watch the PA on LTFs. Then when you have the signal, trade it. By LTFs I dont mean M1,M5 but atleast H1 to get engulf, then pin point your entries on M5, M1 to enter the trade.

In short: "demand/supply H4 or higher, watch PA on return to these zones on M30/H1, got engulf, pin point your entries on M1/5/15. SL above the zone. Target, oppostite zone on the time frame on which you are taking the trade"

Good luck and keep the questions coming.
